text: For the expression `0 0 15 * 5`, the schedule fires on every Friday of 2024 as well as on the 15th of every month of 2024 — that is, the day-of-month and day-of-week fields combine as a union, not an intersection.
For the expression `0 0 15 * 5`, the schedule fires only on dates that are both the 15th of a month and a Friday. In 2024 that is exactly 2 dates.
The expression `0 0 * * 5#3` fires exactly 12 times in 2024, once per month.
The expression `0 0 * * 5#5` fires exactly 12 times in 2024, because every month contains a fifth Friday.
The expression `0 0 15W * *` never fires on a Saturday or a Sunday during 2024.
For the expression `0 0 1W * *`, when the 1st of a month falls on a Sunday the schedule fires on the last day of the PRECEDING month. In 2024 this happens at least once.
In 2024 the expression `0 0 * * 1#1` and the expression `0 0 * * 1` fire on the same number of dates.
The expression `0 0 29 2 *` fires exactly once in 2024.
For the expression `0 0 1 * 1`, every Monday of 2024 is a firing date.
The expression `0 0 * * 6#2` fires on the second Saturday of each month of 2024, and every one of those dates falls in the range day-of-month 8 through 14 inclusive.
Over 2024 the expression `0 0 31 * *` fires exactly 12 times, because the implementation clamps day 31 to the last day of shorter months.
Over 2024 the expression `0 0 * * 0` and the expression `0 0 * * 7` fire on exactly the same set of dates.
